name: Compile an experiment's labsheets
description: turn an experiment's construction and characterization files into a printable workbook — one tab per work session, with what to fetch and from where, what goes in each reaction, what to write on every tube, which controls and what each proves, and the questions the lab wants answered
phrases: make the labsheets for this experiment
turn a construction file into a workbook
what sessions does this experiment need

requires.note: plan, packet and workbook in one gated run
the shape of what comes out
one module per operation — what goes on that kind of sheet

returns: an .xlsx, one tab per session, plus every decision the compiler refused to make and every material it could not locate
notes: GATED: it reports open decisions and unlocated materials before writing, because issuing a sheet with the sequencing oligo undecided means four reactions with somebody else's primer. `cf.plan` is the PLANNING stage alone (c6-plan) and stops at a plan; this is the whole thing. A file in the parenthetical dialect is refused and named rather than compiled into constructs like `Tet)`.
